related.title: ext4：extent 與連續配置
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付雙PID映射及隔離矩陣；不把容器標籤當完整安全邊界證據。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver the dual-PID mapping and isolation matrix; a container label is not proof of a complete security boundary. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 建立logical_start、physical_start、length表；把每段展開回逐塊映射並查任意offset。
related.differenceEn: Tabulate logical_start, physical_start and length; expand each extent to per-block mappings and resolve arbitrary offsets.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
namespace改變資源名稱與觀察視角；PID隔離不自動包含檔案、網路、權限及資源配額隔離。
本課數值核對：3*2 = 6 names；另一項核對：3+1 = 4 processes。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

extent以起點與長度描述連續區塊；邏輯連續不保證實體連續。壓縮metadata不能減少檔案有效資料量。
本課數值核對：100*4096 = 409600 B；另一項核對：100/2 = 50 compression_ratio。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Namespaces change names and observation contexts; PID isolation alone does not isolate files, networks, privileges or quotas.
Numeric audit: 3*2 = 6 names; second audit: 3+1 = 4 processes. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

An extent describes a contiguous block run by start and length; logical continuity does not guarantee physical continuity. Compact metadata does not shrink file payload.
Numeric audit: 100*4096 = 409600 B; second audit: 100/2 = 50 compression_ratio. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: rsync：區塊差異與可重算傳輸預算
related.titleEn: rsync: block differences and reproducible transfer budgets
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付雙PID映射及隔離矩陣；不把容器標籤當完整安全邊界證據。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver the dual-PID mapping and isolation matrix; a container label is not proof of a complete security boundary. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 為每塊計hash與offset，列可重用及需傳送區段；重建後再核對整檔hash。
related.differenceEn: Hash each block with its offset, mark reuse and transfer spans, then verify the reconstructed whole-file hash.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

本課數值核對：3*2 = 6 names；另一項核對：3+1 = 4 processes。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

區塊簽章協助尋找重複內容；真正rsync還有rolling checksum與協定開銷。固定區塊練習只展示差異傳輸的取捨。
本課數值核對：3*4096 = 12288 B；另一項核對：1-3/256 = 0.98828125 saved_fraction。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。

Namespaces change names and observation contexts; PID isolation alone does not isolate files, networks, privileges or quotas.
Numeric audit: 3*2 = 6 names; second audit: 3+1 = 4 processes. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Block signatures identify reusable content; real rsync also has rolling checksums and protocol overhead. The fixed-block exercise illustrates only transfer tradeoffs.
Numeric audit: 3*4096 = 12288 B; second audit: 1-3/256 = 0.98828125 saved_fraction. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
